xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnCommitteeTe: Mr. Gautam Doshi was appointed as Member of Audit Committee with effect from May 25, 2018 and was appointed as the Chairperson of Audit Committee with effect from September 27, 2018.

As a consequence of Mr. Sanjay Asher's retirement, the Board of Directors has, at its meeting held on 31 March 2025, approved the appointment of Ms. Rama Bijapurkar as a Member of Audit Committee with effect from 31 March 2025.

Mr. Sanjay Asher has retired from the Board effective from 31 March 2025 from the closure of business hours, upon completion of his term. Pursuant to his retirement, he ceases to be the Member of the Audit Committee.

Dr. Pawan Goenka, Lead Independent Director, was appointed as a Member of Nomination & Remuneration Committee with effect from May 27, 2021 and was appointed as the Chairperson of Nomination & Remuneration Committee with effect from September 1, 2021.

Mr. Gautam Doshi was appointed as a Member of Stakeholders Relationship Committee with effect from August 14, 2018 and appointed as the Chairperson of Stakeholders Relationship Committee with effect from September 27, 2018.

Dr. Pawan Goenka, Lead Independent Director, was appointed as a Member of Risk Management Committee with effect from May 29, 2022 and appointed as a Chairperson of the Risk Management Committee with effect from August 1, 2024.
Mr. Dilip Shanghvi served as a Chairperson of Risk Management Committee upto August 1, 2024 and thereafter he continues to be a Member.

The designation of the Non-Board Member in the Committee is Chief Financial Officer and is to be mentioned in the category of the Composition of Risk Management Committee as per NSE FAQ. However, there is a validation error while mentioning the same therefore, we have entered Member.
Ms. Rama Bijapurkar was appointed as a Member of CSR Committee with effect from May 27, 2021 and appointed as the Chairperson of CSR Committee with effect from May 26, 2023.
Mr. Dilip Shanghvi served as a Chairperson of CSR Committee upto May 26, 2023 and thereafter he continues to be a Member.

The designation of the Non-Board Member in the Committee is Chief Financial Officer and is to be mentioned in the category of the Composition of Corporate Governance and ESG Committee as per NSE FAQ. However, there is a validation error while mentioning the same therefore, we have entered Member.
